{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify the rows with sentinel values (e.g., 0, -1, -999, 999)
sentinel_mask = df['biomarker_baseline'].isin([0, -1, -999, 999])
sentinel_rows = df[sentinel_mask]

# Display the sentinel rows to understand the pattern
print(sentinel_rows.head())

# Check the distribution of sentinel values
print('\nSentinel value counts:')
print(df['biomarker_baseline'].value_counts().loc[[0, -1, -999, 999]])"}
